description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named 'CursoController' that manages HTTP requests related to 'Curso' (Course) entities, including adding, editing, deleting, and viewing course details.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller handling HTTP requests related to Course management including adding, editing, viewing, and deleting courses.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the form for adding a new course associated with a specific professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new course linked to a professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a course's current data for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing course's information.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a specified course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to view detailed information about a specific course, including user enrollment status.
